tools.name: day_names.for_date
tools.description: Use this when someone gives a date of birth and asks for their Akan or Ghanaian day name (for example "what is my Ghanaian name, I was born on 6 March 1994"), or asks what day name a baby born on a date would have. It works out the weekday itself; do not guess the weekday first. Do not use it for na

tools.name: day_names.for_weekday
tools.description: Use this when someone already knows the weekday and asks for the Akan day names for it (for example "what are the Akan names for someone born on a Friday"), or asks what weekday an Akan day name such as Kofi or Akosua belongs to. Do not use it when a date of birth is given: use day_names.for_date so
